newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Hard-up Kazakh worker goes on a bloody spree.
newsitem.headline: Hard-up Kazakh worker goes on a bloody spree.

text.p: A Kazakh building worker shot his company's chief engineer dead and seriously injured the chief accountant after a row about massive wage delays, the official Kazakhstanskaya Pravda daily said on Wednesday.
The newspaper said the worker, from a construction firm in the western town of Aktau, had demanded that the firm pay wages owed to him for work completed before he quit one month before.
He shot the two with a sawn-off shotgun after the accountant explained there was no money on the company's bank account.

Salary arrears totalling 43 billion tenge ($573 million), have already provoked several nationwide protest actions, but the Aktau case appears to be the most dramatic instance of a worker taking the law into his own hands.
